title: #LenovoThermal

^([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)?@(odata|Redfis.description: This property shall specify a valid odata or Redfish property.

HistoryTempMetric.description: A reference indicating temperature history metric values.
HistoryTempMetric.longDescription: The value of this property shall be a reference indicating temperature history metric values. In this reference shall contain: InletAirTemp, OutletAirTemp, ExpansionInletAirTemp, ExpansionOutletAirTemp metric values.

Thermal.description: This is the schema definitions for OEM Lenovo extended temperature resource.

^([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)?@(odata|Redfis.description: This property shall specify a valid odata or Redfish property.

Location.longDescription: The value of this property shall indicate Fan slot information. The InfoFormat shall be Slot X, like Slot 1.

HistoryFanMetric.description: A reference indicating fan history metric values.
HistoryFanMetric.longDescription: The value of this property shall be a reference indicating fan history metric values. In this reference shall contain: CoolingSubsystemPower metric values.

VariableSpeedEnabled.description: This indicates whether variable speed of a fan is enabled.
VariableSpeedEnabled.longDescription: The value of this property shall be a boolean indicating whether variable speed of a fan is enabled.

DesiredSpeed.description: DesiredSpeed is the currently requested fan speed, defined in Revolutions per Minute.
DesiredSpeed.longDescription: The value of this property shall be a number indicating the currently requested fan speed, defined in Revolutions per Minute.

ActiveCoolingEnabled.description: This indicates whether active cooling of a fan is enabled.
ActiveCoolingEnabled.longDescription: The value of this property shall be a boolean indicating whether active cooling of a fan is enabled.

Fan.description: This is the schema definitions for OEM Lenovo extended fan resource.
